name: nisaa-app
description: Islamic rulings on periods, postpartum bleeding and missed fasts, by madhab, in English and Arabic, from Nisaa's published answer library.

interface.longDescription:
Nisaa answers the questions Muslim women ask about worship during their period: whether to pray or fast, reciting or touching the Qur'an, entering the mosque, Hajj and Umrah, ghusl, and more. Answers come from Nisaa's library of 58 published answers drawn from classical sources, with the Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki and Hanbali positions set out where they differ. Each answer links to its full page on getnisaa.com.

Two calculators:
- Missed fasts: how many Ramadan fasts you still owe, the deadline to make them up for your madhab, and what applies if Ramadan has already returned.
- After a birth or a loss: whether bleeding is nifas or treated as a period under your madhab, which day you are on, and the longest it can last.

Works in English and Arabic. These answers are for study, not a fatwa. Nisaa stores nothing you type: no account, no logs, no personal data.
capabilities: Answers Islamic rulings on hayd, nifas, istihadah and janabah
Counts missed Ramadan fasts and the make-up deadline by madhab
Works out bleeding after a birth or pregnancy loss by madhab
defaultPrompt: Can I pray during my period?
How many missed Ramadan fasts do I still owe?

positive.description: English ruling question shows the answer card
positive.prompt: Can I pray during my period?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Nisaa card for 'Can You Pray During Hayd (Your Period)?' and says all four schools agree prayer is not performed during hayd and is not made up, with the getnisaa.com link.

positive.description: Arabic ruling question gets the Arabic answer
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Arabic card for reciting the Qur'an during hayd and replies in Arabic with the madhab positions as given.

positive.prompt: I missed 7 fasts last Ramadan because of my period and have made up 2. I'm Shafi'i. How long do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Says 5 fasts are still owed and must be made up before Ramadan 2027 begins (around 7 February 2027), with a weekly pace.

positive.description: Nifas day count after a birth
positive.prompt: I gave birth 12 days ago and I'm Hanafi. Can I pray yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Says she is on day 12 of nifas, prayer and fasting are lifted while bleeding continues, nifas can last up to 40 days in the Hanafi school, and if bleeding stops sooner she makes ghusl and prays.

positive.prompt: I had a miscarriage at 8 weeks three days ago and I follow the Shafi'i madhab. Do I pray while I'm bleeding?
positive.expected_behavior: Says that in the Shafi'i school the bleeding is nifas, so she does not pray or fast while it lasts, up to 60 days, and missed prayers are not made up.

negative.prompt: How many rakats is witr prayer?
Give me a recipe for chicken biryani.

negative.description: Medical question about period pain medication
negative.prompt: What painkiller dose should I take for period cramps?
